description: Gate policy used by Section 03 Step 14. Edit this file, then rerun Step 14 to change which evaluation results block the deployment gate or only require human review.

TC-REC-001.rationale: Recommendation quality is useful release evidence, but it can be subjective. Keep this evaluator as review_only so the lab shows the score as a human-review warning instead of stopping the notebook.

Builtin.Correctness.human_review_guidance: Read the answer, expected response, score, and explanation. Decide whether this recommendation quality signal should become a blocking release criterion, remain review-only, or move into the optimization dataset.
